sloka: तान् च स प्रति युद्ध्यन् वै युद्धे राजा प्रवासितः ।हिमवन्तम् उपागम्य भार्याभ्याम् सहितः तदा ॥१-७०-२९॥
transliteration: tān ca sa prati yuddhyan vai yuddhe rājā pravāsitaḥ ।himavantam upāgamya bhāryābhyām sahitaḥ tadā ॥1-70-29॥

translations.english: The king Asita who was a weakling was defeated in the conflict against the kings and was exiled. Along with his counsellors he lived at on the Bhriguprasravana Himavat mountain.
